'''Cheroth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A [[Color/Legends|red]]-[[Hair/Legends|headed]] female with red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], they had olive-colored skin and facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]],<ref name="TOR" /> as was common to members of their [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|318|Mirialan}}</ref> Cheroth wore their hair in a bun, and dressed primarily in green and tan [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]. During the Cold War, Cheroth worked in the [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Junix's Joint]] as a [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cheroth was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. They appeared in Anchorhead, the Republic-only city on Tatooine, as a Cantina Vendor.<ref name="TOR" />
